newsitem.title: USA: AMEX, CBOE to trade General Cable options.
newsitem.headline: AMEX, CBOE to trade General Cable options.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange and the Chicago Board Options Exchange said Monday they would begin trading options on General Cable Corp on August 25.

The options will have initial strike prices of 25, 30 and 35 and introductory expirations in September, October, November and February. At the American Stock Exchange, position limits have been set at 4,500 contracts.
The options will trade in the Chrysler Corp trading crowd at the CBOE. The specialist for the options at the AMEX will be Charlton, Goin, SLK.
